newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Oppenheimer cuts brokerages.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Oppenheimer cuts brokerages.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co downgraded 10 brokerage stocks, citing the group's recent price appreciation.
-- Cut Morgan Keegan Inc, McDonald & Co Investments Inc, Alex. Brown Inc and PaineWebber Group Inc to market perform from buy.
-- Cut Legg Mason Inc, A.G. Edwards Inc, Interra Financial Inc and Raymond James Financial Inc to market perform from outperform.
-- Cut Bear Stearns Cos Inc and Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc to outperform from buy.
-- Reiterated buy rating on Morgan Stanley Group Inc.
-- Actions were confirmed by the office of analyst Steven Eisman.
